answer: AI agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via resource-backed identity. Each agent must stake a unique, scarce computational asset into a secure identity *vault*. This deposit serves as a verifiable *prism* for its authenticity and commitment. Attacking agents would incur an increasing economic burden per fake identity, facing prohibitive costs at the *nadir* of readily available, cheap staking assets, making large-scale Sybil creation economically unfeasible due to high capital outlay.
